name: JL_BR_AP_BANK_RETURNS_ALL
description: Stores information associated with the payment request for the purchases made by a customer.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier that identifies a payment. It is also a foreign key to the IBY_PAYMENTS_ALL table.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: BANK_OCCURRENCE_CODE
columns.description: Occurrence error details sent by the bank. It is also a foreign key to the JL_BR_AR_BANK_OCCURRENCES table.

columns.name: OCCURRENCE_DATE
columns.description: Occurrence error date sent by the bank.

columns.name: PROCESSING_DATE
columns.description: Date when the bank will process the transaction. For example, the process date is different from the occurrence date for a DOC transaction.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BANK_RETURN_ID
columns.description: Value generated during the processing of a payment request. It is passed to bank in a payment request file. It is also used to uniquely refer individual payment requests.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier that identifies a payment instruction. It is also a foreign key to the IBY_PAY_INSTRUCTIONS_ALL table.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_PAYABLE_ID
columns.description: A unique identifier that identifies a payment document. It is also a foreign key to the IBY_DOCS_PAYABLE_ALL table.

columns.name: BANK_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier for a bank party on a bank payment.

columns.name: PAYMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Indicates the payment amount sent to bank.

columns.name: RETURN_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the return received from the bank.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of payment transaction, such as DOC, TED, and collection document.
